tickets.title: Integration by sonic in a separate worktree, reap cherry-picked worktrees
tickets.what: docs/llm/orch-load-2026-11-22.md rank 1 (D-2026-11-22-15): a documented sonic integration job (docs/delegation.md + convention text) cherry-picks a slice into a fresh integration worktree, runs build, build:test, test:mjs twice, test:unit, check:fixtures, and reports at most 10 lines (pass/fail, failing test names, first error line); imp on conflict; the main session decides and pushes. The watcher also reaps closed clean worktrees whose commits are already on the base branch by patch identity (spec §2.1.3 sentence as told to the owner).

acceptance.text: A cherry-picked, clean, closed worktree is reaped; a dirty or unpicked one is kept
The integration brief template is in docs/delegation.md

comments.author: legacy
comments.text: (imp on astra j408a4de6136d2eeb): rev-list --cherry-pick picks; later picks rechecked when the base sha changes (≤4/scan, 7 days); spec §2.1.3 sentence; integration template in docs/delegation.md. First integration by sonic (j67d04ce32de784c3, deepseek flash): clean pick, 1011/1011 twice, 92/92, fixtures OK; main fast-forwarded. tmp/wt-new.sh worktrees are not HUD-managed and are not reaped; use hud_create isolation: worktree for that.

tickets.title: hud_read digest by default
tickets.what: Rank 4: hud_read returns a digest by default (state, one-line result, changed files, verdict/blockers when the report gives them) with mode full for the whole report; batch reads with jobs[]. Spec sentence as told to the owner.

acceptance.text: A long report reads as a digest under 1 KB; mode full returns it whole

tickets.title: Task notices wait for HUD checks and get shorter
tickets.what: Rank 7: the MCP task completion for a job with checks is sent after its HUD checks finish; notices arriving within 3 s coalesce; the notice text drops to state, report path and one-line summary (~140 tokens). Spec §5 MCP-ORCH sentence as told to the owner.

acceptance.text: A job with checks wakes the session once, after the checks

tickets.title: Owner panel actions reach MCP-task clients; retry and land intents
tickets.what: Rank 5: tries.jsonl marks and panel actions are delivered to MCP-task clients too (not only hud watch); r on a failed job and m on a to-try slice write an intent that reaches the main session, which decides (the panel never briefs or chains). Spec §2.1.4 and §2.2.6 sentences as told to the owner.

acceptance.text: Pressing y on a to-try slice reaches a Claude Code task session without hud watch
r and m write an intent the session receives; nothing is dispatched by the panel
